lines.text: Endmin! Long time no see!
Wow. I totally didn't expect the Endmin to get some early dibs on us! Heh. I guess it's time for an intro.
That's right! Mighter was actually on a mission to clean up the breakers' trash when he found the special training arena!
The LBs hid the entrance right behind a pile of tires. The arena is huge and furnished with all sorts of weapons. Would be a shame if we didn't organize a tournament with it.
Heheh. This has everything to do with a legendary UWST heroine — Great-Gran who lives right next door to Mighter!
Yeah. Great-Gran's the Midnight Witch of the First Aggeloi War! She demolished tons of Ankhors with bombs and a jetpack! She even came up with the Double Wings Battle Tactic!
"Double Assault" is the core tactical essence. Duos who can maximize their double-team work will achieve a true synergy, where one plus one becomes more than two. And it's super awesome!
That, my Endmin, is the core of the problem!
The core of the contradiction!
We studied Great-Gran's notes. Battles after the great war no longer allowed the Double Wings Battle Tactic to shine. People soon forgot about it...
That's why we're putting together an Arena tailor-made for the Double Assault! Every contender will discover the fun of having a battle buddy! Interested in giving a shot, Endmin?
The Arena is open to contenders of every age, race, and faction! Create a team of two with a buddy to start fighting!
Ah, Simonch just called Mighter for debriefing. Mighter's the one who found the site for us!
We Welles Brothers Three are jointly organizing a special event! The 1st Double Assault Legends Tourney of Talos-II!

options: Sounds incredible! Why haven't I heard of it before...?
I heard you're planning a new event.
Planning a new event? Tell me more.
Is that it...? And where's your big brother?

lines.text: Interested in a taking on a most exhilarating battle, Endmin?

options: Yeah. Show me to your arena. NOW!
I need to prep for a bit.

lines.text: Endmin, we designed several new activities for the Double Assault arena. Wanna give them a go?
What do you think, Endmin? Have you discovered the fun of our special arena?
Do you now fully appreciate the unique combat approach when fighting as a team of two?
Of course! Remember what I told you, Lywen? The Endmin will figure it out instantly!
You see, Lywen? Remember what I told you? This is the Endmin. We gotta max out the difficulty!
That's right, Damon! That's exactly what I thought! How about fighting a few more arena battles and getting the complete experience?
Oh yeah, before the arena fad runs out, we hope to gather as much combat data as possible from our contenders!
If you got any interesting ideas, swing by the arena and try them out! We'll jot them down as well!
We'll do our best to include them in the next arena events! We want people to see double assault, learn about double assault, and fall in love with double assault! Just like us!
